text: Risk management is the process of dealing with possible problems before they happen. First, it is important to identify risks, which means finding things that could go wrong in a project or business. After that, you should create mitigation strategies to reduce the chance or impact of these risks. For example, you might buy insurance or train your staff better. It is also wise to prepare contingency plans, which are backup plans you can use if a risk actually happens. Finally, you must keep monitoring the situation, because new risks can appear at any time. Good risk management helps you stay calm and make smart decisions.
